_about: The 25 observed behaviours with domain, what to look for, the competency each is evidence for, and the interpretation texts (section 5.8).

parameters.name: Confidence / composure
parameters.description: Maintains a calm, credible, and steady presence when speaking or being challenged.

parameters.name: Accountability / follow-through
parameters.description: Owns actions, closes loops, and stays answerable for tasks and commitments.

parameters.name: Emotional regulation
parameters.description: Remains composed and professional under pressure or disagreement.

parameters.name: Openness to feedback
parameters.description: Receives input constructively and adjusts behaviour accordingly.

parameters.name: Clarity of message
parameters.description: Communicates main point understandably and without confusion.

parameters.name: Structure of message
parameters.description: Uses logical flow, framing, and closure.

parameters.name: Active listening
parameters.description: Shows attention, paraphrases, and builds on what others say.

parameters.name: Adaptation to audience
parameters.description: Adjusts language and level of detail to the audience.

parameters.name: Conciseness
parameters.description: Communicates efficiently without unnecessary detail.

parameters.name: Participation
parameters.description: Contributes appropriately and consistently in group work.

parameters.name: Respectful interaction
parameters.description: Shows professionalism, respect, and constructive tone.

parameters.name: Influence in group
parameters.description: Shapes discussion positively without overpowering others.

parameters.name: Conflict handling
parameters.description: Handles disagreement calmly and productively.

parameters.name: Collaboration
parameters.description: Works effectively toward shared outcomes with others.

parameters.name: Problem definition
parameters.description: Frames the actual issue before trying to solve it.

parameters.name: Logical thinking
parameters.description: Explains reasoning coherently and step by step.

parameters.name: Idea generation
parameters.description: Produces useful options and alternatives.

parameters.name: Decision quality
parameters.description: Makes sensible choices and explains trade-offs.

parameters.name: Initiative
parameters.description: Steps forward without waiting to be told.

parameters.name: Ownership
parameters.description: Acts as if the outcome matters personally.

parameters.name: Guiding others
parameters.description: Helps organise, guide, or support peers effectively.

parameters.name: Presence / authority
parameters.description: Projects grounded, credible authority that others respond to.

parameters.name: Learning speed
parameters.description: Improves quickly across activities and days.

parameters.name: Applies feedback
parameters.description: Converts feedback into visible behavioural change.

parameters.name: Reflection quality
parameters.description: Can identify what worked, what did not, and what to change.

parameterTexts.interpretationLow: Below required standard for current role level or batch expectation.
parameterTexts.actionLow: Targeted coaching, deliberate practice, feedback follow-up, and observation in next workshop.
parameterTexts.signalHigh: Possible growth, stretch assignment, mentoring exposure, or leadership-readiness signal if consistent.
